description: Mesogeos is the Orion Lab and University of Valencia research team's datacube for data-driven wildfire modelling in the wider Mediterranean region. It contains daily weather, vegetation, land cover, terrain, population, road-distance and fire variables on a one-kilometre grid. Coverage runs from 1 April 2006 to 29 September 2022. The provider publishes Zarr data, machine-learning track extracts and access notebooks through a linked Google Drive folder, with creation and benchmark code documented on GitHub. The README states CC-BY-4.0 licence terms and free public access. A limitation is that the former OVH storage endpoint is no longer supported. The README also gives differing Zenodo identifiers in its badge and citation, so this record uses the verified project repository as its canonical address. Mesogeos supports wildfire hazard and infrastructure-exposure simulations. EFFIS (data-effis) supplies its fire observations. No datacube, track data or notebook outputs were downloaded.
